proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10158 mukha explicitly gives Khowar mux “face”, with the same mouth-to-face polysemy in Middle Indo-Aryan and neighboring languages. The Khowar x spelling is directly documented. Joint comparison: DewasDoneDanuwar mux “face” matches reviewed Kho mux “face” (f_xegmophmwgm46). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
